steps.en: Install from source and copy the config template
steps.zh: 从源码安装，复制配置模板

steps.en: Create a CopilotKit Intelligence project and keep its server-only key in .env
steps.zh: 建 Intelligence 项目，key 写进 .env
steps.code: npx copilotkit@latest login · npx copilotkit@latest project select

steps.en: Start the API and the app
Serves chat plus a durable task engine over PGlite at localhost:8081
steps.zh: 在 localhost:8081 提供聊天和建在 PGlite 上的持久任务引擎

steps.en: Delegate from the phone or web chat
steps.zh: 在手机上或网页聊天里派活
steps.code: Check out Hacker News for cool stuff

steps.en: Drives a persistent Chromium and streams browser/PDF/plan cards inline
steps.zh: 驾驶保活的 Chromium，把浏览器/PDF/计划卡片流回聊天

steps.en: Pauses side effects for your review; Take control opens its live session
steps.zh: 写操作停下等你审批；Take control 可直接打开它的实时会话

value.en: You walk away and the errand keeps running — every action reviewed, receipted, and resumable, and you can take over its browser mid-task
value.zh: 人走开，差事还在跑——每个动作有审批、有回执、可续跑，任务中途还能直接接管它的浏览器

https://github.com/CopilotKit/openmuse/blob/main/README.md Try it (Check out Hacker News for cool stuff; Take control; approval-gated sends)
